adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when validation fails (`handleAdd`), but it is not reset in the mutation `onSuccess` handler. Since the dialog component remains mounted (rendered in `BookingListItem` regardless of `isOpenDialog`), reopening the dialog can show the stale warning (`{isInvalidEmail && ...}`) even after a successful add, because only `setMultiEmailValue([""])` and `setIsOpenDialog(false)` are called on success. It is only cleared on the Cancel button path.
